plan.notes: Source: official St. Thomas Aquinas College (stac.edu) sample four-year sequence for the Computer Science major, transcribed manually 2026-09-30 from https://stac.edu/academics/school-of-stem/program-courses/computer-science-program-courses/ (School of STEM > Program Courses > Computer Science). Transcription method: fetched the official page, extracted the <tr> table rows from the raw HTML, and transcribed codes, titles, credits, requirement labels, and printed term totals verbatim. TRUE degree name: BS in Computer Science (program page https://stac.edu/program/computer-science/ lists 'At a glance: ... BS, 4 years'). Catalog year 2022-2023: the official sequence page carries no catalog-year stamp; article:published_time is 2022-12-19 with no modified date; it remains the live official sequence page as of 2026-09-30. The official 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog PDF (linked from https://stac.edu/academics/college-catalogs/) stalls on download from this environment, so cross-year verification against the newest catalog could not be completed — coordinator may re-check on a clean connection. Total credits: 123, the sequence's own published term totals (16/16, 16/16, 15/15, 15/15), NOT the college's 120-credit published degree length (STAC's official policy states 'The published length for an undergraduate degree at St Thomas Aquinas College is 120 credits' — https://stac.edu/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/STAC-SAP-Policy.pdf). Per the established Clarkson/UVM/GCSU precedent, total_credits follows the sequence's own published total; the 3-credit discrepancy is documented honestly here. No prereqs are published on the sequence page (prereq arrays left empty; external_prereqs empty) — prereqs are stated in the course catalog, not the sequence page. Choice slots: SCIENCE rows (choose one of ASTR, BIO, CHEM, FS, KIN, PHY, or SCI, a Major Requirement); 'Breadth & Proficiency' rows (Stage Requirement); 'CS Elective' rows; 'Free Elective / Minor' rows; 'Gateway 1/2' rows (Stage Requirement). STAC 101/102/201 are required 1-credit courses whose titles are not published on the sequence page — labeled verbatim with that caveat. Category mapping follows the page's own requirement labels: Major Requirement -> major, Stage Requirement -> gened, Elective Requirement -> elective. Page oddity transcribed verbatim: Fall Year 4 lists one 'Free Elective / Minor' row as 'Major Requirement' (likely a page typo; flagged in the course note).
